semiconductor_relevance: Medium — TATSUTA Electric Wire and Cable provides specialized materials and components for thermal management and electromagnetic shielding, which are important in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: TATSUTA Electric Wire and Cable offers advanced materials and components for the semiconductor industry, focusing on thermal management solutions and electromagnetic shielding. Their products include thermal via pastes and high-performance heat dissipation blocks, as well as electromagnetic shielding films for flexible printed circuits.
capabilities: Thermal via paste with heat dissipation capability of 40-60 W/m·K
High-performance heat dissipation block rated at 550 W/m·K
Electromagnetic shielding films for FPC and FFC
